research.notes: General email is obfuscated on the contact page, so omitted. The agenda's 'College Track Oakland' is a local site of the national College Track nonprofit; the registry entity is the national organization based in Oakland. A separate registered entity, 'San Francisco College Track Qalicb Inc', exists but is not the vendor.

profile.summary: College Track is a nonprofit that supports first-generation students from under-resourced communities through a program that runs from high school through college graduation. Its goal is to help students earn a bachelor's degree. It operates in several communities, including Oakland, and is headquartered in Oakland, California.

review.notes: ProPublica shows College Track (EIN 94-3279613) as a 501(c)(3) in Oakland, and collegetrack.org confirms the HQ address, phone, mission, and an Oakland site; the agenda's 'College Track Oakland' is that organization's local site, which fits a no-cost student data sharing agreement. The summary is neutral and supported.
